card_en: To say what hurts, the body part is the subject and the person takes me: boli me glava, literally the head hurts me. With several body parts the verb is bolijo: bolijo me noge.

you (to someone close).en: Does your head hurt? (to someone close)

quick_check.explain_en: The person in pain takes me, not mi: boli me glava.

helper_de: Like der Kopf tut mir weh, the body part is the subject. But Slovenian uses me, like mich, not mi.
helper_en: English says my head hurts. Slovenian says the head hurts me, so glava stays the same and only me changes with the person.
